tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Knot complements in $S^3$ as $K(G,1)$'s] ↗ def:k-g-1-space ↗ ex:xmn-universal-cover-construction 1. ch1:1B.6\group Fundamental Group

For a nonempty closed connected $K\subset S^3$, $S^3-K$ is a $K(G,1)$ by 3-manifold theory. For torus knots this follows from the deformation retraction to $X_{m,n}$ and its contractible universal cover. \end{example}
